senses.example: Toma una pastilla cada ocho horas.
senses.exampleGloss: Take one tablet every eight hours.

alternatives.reason: Pharmacy/formal synonym; the box says comprimido, people say pastilla.
Used for chocolate or a device; only medical in specific contexts.
The general category, not one dose.

notes: Also the everyday word for a soap bar (pastilla de jabón) and a stock cube; those senses are deliberately deferred.
